{"action_id":"rewrite_priority","rationale":"The grouped priority rewrite is the stronger structural choice for reducing whole-design maximum arrival: it replaces the encoder's recursive selection and subsequent one-hot decoding with parallel local winners and group enables. It preserves highest-bit priority and the all-zero behavior (valid=0, index=0, onehot=1), while leaving all mux behavior unchanged. The mux's 0.50 ns input delay is included in this assessment; exact timing improvement and compliance with the 2719.608320 um^2 area limit remain unverified without mapped PPA results."}
